text: The meta part of tasks/023 landed (cc49bfa, 6ba2241; card meta_agent/tasks/023-data-hosts-a-built-agent-may-fetch-from.md, last section). Profile lab-kyu-softmatter v5 carries under policy.execution_permission.data_sources exactly gitlab.com and pseudopotentials.quantum-espresso.org, each read_only_anonymous, on 'Every agent of this lab'; level, words and package_sources unchanged. The Designer copies data_sources into envelope/execution_permission.json as it copies package_sources, and stops where a network tool's install or fetch is not on its own list, or it names neither. Template v15 is the latest: src/gate.py opens a network tool as an install, a read (every fetches_from host under data_sources with the same access) or both, neither list opening the other; src/run_tool.py looks for an installer only where installs_from is named. Shown on two kinds (an electronic-structure engine's pseudopotentials and examples; a weather station's archive), the gate tests watched failing on v14 first. Asked of the design role: the index row of 023 stays open until round three of tasks/018 (a fresh clone with meta_agent/eval/briefs/clone-quantum-espresso.txt) shows the fetch tools open; that run is the design seat's holding 018. No build changed.
